_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-22. CardID = 17600 + idx; 359 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 59). Pandora's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's and the rest: only deck.identity (data/tts/pandora.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Hero card: PANDORA, MELEE, START HEALTH 14, MOVE 2 (unmatched-memory agrees). Sidekick KAKODAEMON, MELEE, START HEALTH 1 x2, move 2: the save has two Custom_Token objects nicknamed Thanatos and Olethros (no life dial) and the hero card says 'Do not start with any Kakodaemons on the board'.

Bands read from the images: PANDORA on Hera's Curiosity, Hindsight, Divine Intervention, Offering to the Gods, Celestial Raiments and Zeus's Mischief; KAKODAEMON on Spite and Malice (only a Kakodaemon may play them); ANY on Aphrodite's Beauty, Feint, Guided by the Fates and Forged by Hephaestus. Order on the sheet: Hera's Curiosity 0-2, Hindsight 3-5, Aphrodite's Beauty 6-8, Spite 9-10, Divine Intervention 11-12, Feint 13-15, Guided by the Fates 16-18, Malice 19-20, Offering to the Gods 21-22, Celestial Raiments 23-24, Zeus's Mischief 25-26, Forged by Hephaestus 27-29.

Discrepancy with unmatched-memory (the card wins): Aphrodite's Beauty is printed value 0 and BOOST 3 (unmatched-memory: 3 and 2), band ANY. Everything else (titles, copies, type, value, BOOST, 30 cards, texts) agrees with the images.

The seven MISERIES are a separate deck of sheet 177 (8x2, CardIDs 17700-17706, a Deck in the bag): Woe 17700, Toil 17701, Pain 17702, Misfortune 17703, Hope 17704, Greed 17705, Confusion 17706 (the order of the image; the Deck object lists them 17706..17700 from the top).

Pandora's Feint (idx 13-15) is word for word Medusa's Feint, and Medusa's idx 15 has the same CardID 17615: two equal Card values in two decks of one sheet, which tests/test_card_identity.py forbids (a card is told from the rival's by value when the id repeats). The three Feints carry the tag `pandora` so that they differ; nothing reads the tag.
